---

**Pipeline to support a new model**
1. set model level --> update this table
2. accuracy test
3. write doc according to level --> update model support list
4. fix issues
5. add feature test and performance improve

- tutorials doc
- ci: accuracy test
- ci: perf test
- ci: feature test
